Start.Name: original_01_cbfc4ad349c1
Start.Text:
早安。
待会儿还有个采访，对吧

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_01_original_04_5d6fb52831a9
l2d_voice#2.Text: 谢谢你，初华。无论是现在……还是刚才

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_02_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_005
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我今天是来说一件事的

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_04_original_02_c8d89603ac7a
l2d_voice#2.Text: 啊，不对…… 花也是有生命的……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_05_original_06_ee2b82b1538f
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我都给忘了。不是吧，现在……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_06_original_09_0b5c2cd31d30
l2d_voice#2.Text: ……嗯。 我这边，也处理得很好

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_07_original_03_3219359ada01
l2d_voice#2.Text: ——你愿意，将剩余的人生交给我吗？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_original_07_99bb7a4cfcf3
l2d_voice#2.Text: （既然如此，我能为睦做的事情就是……）

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_152
l2d_voice#2.Text: 这是最后通牒。 今后不准再跟我扯上关系

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_10_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_135
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我哪里误会了？ 你说的话和做的事互相矛盾

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_11_original_05_5de4e9578eaa
l2d_voice#2.Text: 全都接下来确实有难度呢。 我们筛选一下吧

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_12_original_08_6a2ebc205df1
l2d_voice#2.Text: 你究竟怎么想的？ 为什么要做那样下作的事？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_13_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_127
l2d_voice#2.Text: 到现在还执着于过去，真不像话。 你也该忘记了吧？

talk_short.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_005
talk_short.Text: 我今天是来说一件事的

talk_short.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_024
talk_short.Text: ……就算我不在你们也能练习吧？

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_026
talk_medium.Text:
想练习的话自己练不就好了。
又没有规定练习必须全员到齐。
……不要怪到别人身上

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_01_028
talk_medium.Text:
不要讲这种撒娇的话！
灯，你是最需要练习的人，
但你至今都在做什么？

talk_medium.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_125
talk_medium.Text:
想演奏是你们的自由。
你们就请便吧

talk_long.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_127
talk_long.Text:
到现在还执着于过去，真不像话。
你也该忘记了吧？

talk_long.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_135
talk_long.Text:
我哪里误会了？
你说的话和做的事互相矛盾

talk_long.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_137
talk_long.Text:
CRYCHIC已经毁了。
绝对不可能再复活

talk_long.Name: adv_voice_mygo_001_1_14_152
talk_long.Text:
这是最后通牒。
今后不准再跟我扯上关系
